swap.Drawing weekends at the home studio, wit: A faces and portraits weekend at Pike Street Studios, with two models and twelve people at most.
swap.Two days, ten till four, in the studio w: Two days, ten till four, in a light-filled studio on Capitol Hill. Saturday is the head in simple shapes and likeness; Sunday is expression, light and one finished portrait.

swap.Drawing weekends at the home studio, wit: An urban sketching weekend around the Ferry Building and the Embarcadero, rain or shine.
swap.Two days, ten till four, in the studio w: Two days, nine till three, out on the streets. Saturday is perspective by eye along the waterfront; Sunday we add people and quick colour in North Beach.

swap.Drawing weekends at the home studio, wit: Drawing people from life at RiNo Art Hall, with a model both days.
swap.Two days, ten till four, in the studio w: Two days, ten till four, in a warehouse studio in the River North arts district. Saturday is gesture and proportion; Sunday is faces, hands and longer poses.

swap.Drawing weekends at the home studio, wit: An urban sketching weekend starting at the Cultural Center, with the Loop as our studio.
swap.Two days, ten till four, in the studio w: Two days, nine till three. Saturday we draw the big buildings along Michigan Avenue; Sunday we sketch people and the river walk, with lunch indoors if it's cold.

swap.Drawing weekends at the home studio, wit: A faces and portraits weekend at the Dumbo Drawing Room, under the bridge.
swap.Two days, ten till four, in the studio w: Two days, ten till four, in a studio with a view of the Manhattan Bridge. Saturday is likeness and features; Sunday is expression, light and one finished portrait.
